How we work together

Four clear stages, from first message to final files.

  1. Brief

    You share the genre, audience, references and where the art will appear.

  2. Direction

    We agree on composition, key elements, title treatment and style.

  3. Production

    I build the artwork and you review it with a clear round of feedback.

  4. Delivery

    You receive final files sized for every agreed platform.

Hi, I’m Micheal.

I’m a game artist focused on Steam capsule art, key art and expressive visual design. I care about a memorable first impression that stays true to the game.
